about: Real scans replayed by real.test.ts. Photos and diagnostic records are people's own and stay out of the repository: each `photo` is a path under SCANNER_REAL_DIR. `art` is what the art recognizer scored on that phone, for a replay without the bundle.

photos.note: Bryan, 15 Nov 2026 (scan_samples 9288fda7): a foil SOI Westvale Abbey // Ormendahl in a blue box, 2160 x 3840 camera. The art locked Wei Night Raiders (PTK 89) at 0.658 on two frames; the title is plainly readable. A 640 px photo, so a title-only replay.
